content: Wan Kamnda tǝ nafiya 144,000
Tǝrgha ƙǝlee ɗǝ, a mbed na Wan kamnda ƙǝt a ten Wumnda Sihiyona, tǝ nafiya 144,000 a thlǝmadghǝn chireethleng nanda thlǝm Wan Kamnda hai tǝ Chin a pǝmnggindan.
Tǝrgha sǝk urarha ni hai a talara a riirha ƙǝla rid hwad aama, ƙǝla tǝrˈyaana. Uradɗi sǝk ni nǝghǝn ƙǝla riirha ɗǝk ƙǝliingya.

Kanda a aah amshe pǝling a mbed tsǝnggam kutǝryidɗi, tǝ ǝnggini na tǝ yibrha fa faɗa, tǝ shinggini. Mbǝ niifa sǝ na mbang tsaha amshi ɗi wa ƙǝl nafini na 144,000 kee, fingya ni hǝrghang nanda kanda hu ƙǝshiirha.

Nafina ni ya sǝɓang ngwa fandan ɗǝ tǝ nishya, ƙǝsǝr tsau nda chahal. Kanda ni mbuwa samad Wan Kamnda kala mbǝrha ɗǝnǝn sa ɗǝ. Kanda ni hǝrǝkka ahur fingya nafiya na hu ƙǝshiirha, na nda ƙǝla wan ˈwad ǝnnarhami yi ǝn huɗarha nǝm fǝrang nda Faara tǝ Wan kamnda.
ˈWawanda nggaɓaarha wa, tǝƙǝm mbǝ aibe sǝ a fandan wa.
Fathlǝngya Faara mahan

Tǝrgha nggǝryi na tǝthlǝnda Faara a pǝra hu a fǝrakh amshi, nǝghǝn tǝ Laɓara mii na Mbǝnggǝn yi pakwanɗǝ na a pǝrghǝnǝn a fingya natǝ tsaurhahu ƙǝshiirha, a kala chehweeya, tǝ a kala turya, tǝ kala miiya, tǝ fiya.

Tǝranggǝn uradghǝn sǝ kaan, ndǝghǝn, “Tǝrmama Faara, tǝƙǝm fǝraman mamnggirha thlǝmnggǝn! Ƙǝsǝr nanǝnya, ɓad sayi ɓa nǝn a ngwang kumarha fiya sǝ hǝu. Ɗǝfaman shilee in, ndǝghǝn ǝnagha talara tǝ ƙǝshiirha, tǝ wuri aama, tǝƙǝm fereeya aama!”
Tǝthlǝnda Faara yi sǝri takkwa yanɗa nǝn hai ˈwagha ɓa, ndǝghǝn, “Fǝlɗa hai, Mbabila na manggǝn fǝlɗa hai! Yanɗi kyangga chehweeya hǝu hu nggaala tǝ aam inabi ǝnana susuwaya!”

Tǝrgha tǝthlǝnda Faara yi mahan takkwa fingya yina nǝn hai sǝri. Tǝranggǝn uradghǝn sǝ ndǝghǝn, “Kala niifa ɗǝfangga shilee maɓidɗi teena tǝ shishing ndǝghǝn, tǝƙǝm thlǝ djarra ndǝrɗakh ɗanǝn a pumnggǝn, ko a harghǝn,

nǝn a saa aam inabi yi hufrha hur Faara, ǝna nanda tǝ shembedghǝn irang nanda hu wuhuleurha hai yi hufrha hur Faara. Na nda a sǝsang nda kaan tǝ waarha tǝ tsal waarha, a mbed fathlǝngya Faara na chahal tǝƙǝm a mbed Wan Kamndǝɗi

Ini waarha yi sǝsang kanda nǝn naarha thliirha talara ɗǝ pakwanɗǝ. Nafini na a tǝrang shilee maɓidɗi teena tǝ shishing ndǝghǝn mba nda tam wal yibrha wa nda fǝɗikrha tǝ yanfara tǝ kala niifa thlǝgha ndǝrɗaha hu thlǝmnggǝn.”
Ndaarha ni nanǝnya nafiya Faara na chahal na a ǝna taara tǝ ˈya ndaana Faara a tsawa nda tǝ munyarha tǝ ƙǝrǝsta na nda tǝ shembe fǝrƙǝkafek fa a Yeeso.

Tǝrgha nggǝryi sǝk urarha hai a talara a ndaarha, “Chireethlǝng ǝnɗa hai ya, fa parkayani nafiya na a mǝra hu Chinǝm nanǝnya!” Ndagha Sǝsǝna, “Ƙǝkafek na nda a yibrha hu njiten tar ndan, ƙǝsǝr ka ǝn ǝnad ndan nǝn a takkwa kanda.”
Hathla Ƙǝshiirha
Tǝrgha ƙǝleeɗǝ, na hashmbe ni pǝpet a frakh amshi, tǝ niifa ƙǝla Wan Niifa tsau hu hashmbiɗi, nǝghǝn tǝ tǝtar tǝfasa yi kutǝryirha atenggǝn, nǝghǝn tǝ ɗǝhwasarha ha na chimnggǝn.

Tǝrgha kyagha tǝthlǝnda Faara ɓa fadɗǝn hu Kǝn Faara aah farha nǝn tǝ urarha na manggǝn a yanɗi na tsau hu hashmbiɗi, nagha a ndaarha, “Tǝrang ɗǝhwasad wa katǝrangga hathla hai, ƙǝsǝr sayid hathla ɓaɗa ɓa nanǝnya, nakhɗa ǝnnarhami na hu ƙǝshiirha nakhɗa ɗǝ kaan na a halthgha hai.”
Nanǝn kee, yanɗi na tsau hu hashmbiɗi wiwiɗanggǝn ɗǝhwasadghǝn hu ƙǝshiirha hai, hathlang ngganda ƙǝshiirha hai.
Nggǝrgha tǝthlǝnda Faara kyagha ɓa hu Ƙǝn Faara a talara, ndǝghǝn nggi ƙǝm nǝghǝn tǝ ɗǝhwasarha a harghǝn na chimnggǝn kaan.

Tǝrgha nggǝrgha tǝthlǝnda Faara kyaghaɓa faɗǝn, ndǝghǝn ni aten wadɗi ha na a mbǝd fǝr sataka. Tǝranggǝn uradghǝn sǝ aah yanɗa nǝn natǝ ɗǝhwasadɗa ha na chimnggǝn, ndanggǝn, “Tǝrang ɗǝhwasad wa na chimnggǝn wumangga ƙǝnda wan ɗǝfya inabi na hu ƙǝshiirha, ƙǝsǝr wanggighǝn nakhɗan nda.”
Tǝrgha tǝthlǝnɗǝ ɗi muwanggǝn ɗǝhwasadghǝn hu ƙǝshiirha hai, thlenggǝn wangya inabi ɗa hai tsamanggǝn kanda a mbǝd ˈyaɗa inabi hai yi hufrha hur Faara.

Tsathlang ngganda wan ɗǝfya inabi ɗa hai a ƙǝsǝr wupǝri ɗi, nagha fara a ira hai a mbǝd ˈyaɗa wan ɗǝfya inabi ɗi sǝl iundǝghǝn a ƙǝƙǝrang ɗǝm tǝ sǝsal ƙǝƙǝrra sǝlɗǝ 1,600, ndam kilomita haru mahan, kuɗimndǝghǝn sǝlɗǝ nzang nda lidzam pǝrshe sara mikki, iundǝghǝn mel hau sǝri, ɗangkam ndǝghǝn pǝne tal tǝ mbeera.
